monitored_text: HP Multi Jet Fusion (MJF) 3D printing service What is HP Multi Jet Fusion (MJF) ? HP Multi Jet Fusion (MJF) is capable of generating functional prototypes and end-use parts with complex geometries and complex assemblies. Parts can be printed in full color, allowing designers to test the aesthetics of a product without the lead times or costs of post-processing. MJF can also produce chemically-resistant and highly dense parts, making it ideal for watertight applications and enclosures. HP MJF 3D printing is a powder bed fusion process that creates strong parts with high dimensional accuracy. Because MJF doesn’t require support structures, the process allows more design freedom than many other 3D printing processes.
